sections.title: Two Pointers: Converging or paired pointers over a sequence
Sliding Window: A window that grows and shrinks over a sequence
Prefix Sum: Precomputed running totals for range queries
Fast & Slow Pointers: Cycle detection and finding midpoints
Merge Intervals: Sort then sweep over overlapping ranges
Cyclic Sort: In-place placement when values fall in a range
Binary Search: Halving a sorted search space, or an answer space
Hashing: O(1) lookup and frequency counting
Stack: Matching, parsing, and undo-style problems
Monotonic Stack: Next greater/smaller element in one pass
Linked List: In-place reversal and pointer manipulation
Tree DFS: Preorder, inorder, postorder traversal
Tree BFS: Level order traversal
Trie: Prefix trees for word search and autocomplete
Graph DFS/BFS: Connected components, shortest paths
Topological Sort: Ordering with dependencies
Union Find: Grouping and connectivity
Heap / Priority Queue: Top K elements, k-way merge, running median
Backtracking: Build a solution incrementally, undo on failure
Dynamic Programming (1D): State depends on a small number of prior states
Dynamic Programming (2D/Grid): State depends on a grid or two sequences
Knapsack: 0/1 and unbounded subset selection
Greedy: Locally optimal choice at each step
Bit Manipulation: XOR tricks, bitmasking
